reply: For in situ monitoring of glucose and lactate in an aqueous cell culture medium, Raman spectroscopy is a promising primary method due to its suitability for aqueous environments and ability to provide a molecular fingerprint of metabolites like glucose and lactate. NIR spectroscopy could serve as a comparison method, particularly for tracking glucose concentrations in the millimolar range. Calibration strategies and probe selection remain open questions.
